chunks: This is the farthest limit of their knowledge. Surely your Lord alone knows best who has strayed away from the path and who has come to guidance.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the limits of human knowledge versus God's knowledge regarding guidance?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah An-Najm, this verse serves as a divine rebuttal to the Quraysh's claim of superior knowledge, emphasizing that while human judgment is limited, Allah’s knowledge is absolute and comprehensive. Shia exegesis often highlights this as a reminder that true guidance (hidayah) and misguidance (dalalah) are ultimately determined by God’s will and knowledge, reinforcing the concept of divine omniscience over human speculation.
